options.name: Secular court bias
options.desc: The secular branch of the country's judiciary tends to pass exaggerated judgement and their interpretation of law favours the anti-establishment.

options.name: Questionable secular court impartiality
options.desc: There are instances of religious courts passing far-fetched judgement or interpretation in favour o the anti-establishment.

options.name: Impartial secular courts
options.desc: There is no bias in secular courts. All their judgements comply standards of correct law interpretation
